skonester_acm_create_armor_artifact_on_owner_effect = {
    if = {
      limit = {
        OR = {
          scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator = { OR = {
            has_character_flag = skonester_acm_arm_leather
            has_character_flag = skonester_acm_arm_chain
            has_character_flag = skonester_acm_arm_scale
          } }
          AND = {
            NOT = { exists = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator }
            scope:root = { OR = {
            has_character_flag = skonester_acm_arm_leather
            has_character_flag = skonester_acm_arm_chain
            has_character_flag = skonester_acm_arm_scale
          } }
          }
        }
        OR = {
          scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator = { var:skonester_acm_craft_quality_wealth = 500 }
          AND = {
            NOT = { exists = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator }
            scope:root = { var:skonester_acm_craft_quality_wealth = 500 }
          }
        }
      }
      create_artifact = { name = skonester_cheat_menu_artifact_armor_name description = skonester_cheat_menu_artifact_generic_desc creator = scope:skonester_acm_craft_creator type = armor_mail template = unique_artifact_template visuals = armor wealth = 500 quality = 500 decaying = no modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier generate_history = no save_scope_as = skonester_new_crafted_artifact }
